spec.title: Economic impact of platform consolidation
spec.lead: Enterprise benchmarks confirm rapid payback and multi-year ROI from Google Cloud analytics.

items.label: Industry benchmark: 3-year ROI
items.text: Composite enterprises modernizing onto BigQuery and Looker realize strong multi-year returns with payback under six months.
items.title: 205% · Industry benchmark: 3-year ROI

items.label: Industry benchmark: hours saved
items.text: Engineering and analytics teams eliminate thousands of annual hours spent on pipeline maintenance and ad hoc reporting.
items.title: 5,200 · Industry benchmark: hours saved

spec.takeaway: Industry benchmarks from Forrester and McKinsey validate the financial case for consolidating onto BigQuery and Looker.
spec.notes:
Independent industry research confirms the financial return of consolidating onto Google Cloud. Forrester reports a 205% three-year ROI and 5,200 engineering hours saved annually on BigQuery and Looker, with payback in under six months. McKinsey further notes that mature data governance drives 15% to 20% higher operational efficiency.

Sources:
[1] The Total Economic Impact™ Of Google Cloud's BigQuery And Looker (Forrester Consulting, 2023) https://cloud.google.com/resources/forrester-tei-looker-bigquery
